verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents Automations as its built-in scheduler under a cron-jobs page. It persists jobs, wakes the agent at the right time, and delivers output to a chat channel, a webhook, or nowhere. Webhook and Gmail PubSub triggers and standing orders extend this for autonomous programs. A community user independently reports scheduling tasks across 9 agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurrence syntax (cron expressions or intervals) and job management details beyond the summary excerpts.
